classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: tiles are read by the separate _prefetch process into a bounded queue while the main loop computes (probe.sleep_seconds(compute_s)), so each tile file's single read_staged is overlapped rather than waited on.

classes.name: masks
classes.reason: each iteration of the main loop calls probe.read_staged on one mask file inline and times it as gated stall before it can proceed to the compute sleep, and only the calling rank is held (no collective barrier).
